newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-India win toss, elect to bat in cup final
newsitem.headline: Cricket-India win toss, elect to bat in cup final

text.p: India won the toss and elected to bat against South Africa in the final of the Titan Cup triangular one-day series on Wednesday.
India made one change from the side that beat Australia last week, by bringing in right-hand batsman Sanjay Manjrekar in place of injured opener Navjot Sidhu.

India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Sanjay Manjrekar, Mohammed Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Robin Singh, Ajay Jadeja, Nayan Mongia, Sunil Joshi, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble, Venkatesh Prasad. 12th man - Aashish Kapoor.

South Africa - Hansie Cronje (captain), Gary Kirsten, Andrew Hudson, Pat Symcox, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Fanie de Villiers, Allan Donald, Nicky Boje. 12th man - Herscelle Gibbs.
Umpires - S. Venkataraghavan and V. K. Ramaswamy (both Indian).
